experiment_data.hypothesis: The 6 overlapping features between Binoculars and our 19-feature set (ppl_mean, ppl_var, ppl_median, p10_ppl, p90_ppl, skewness_ppl) capture the core depth signal. If 6-feature RF ≈ 78%, the overlap features alone are sufficient and shape features add negligible value. If 6-feature RF significantly < 78%, the remaining shape features (var_surprisal, kurtosis, etc.) have independent discriminative contribution beyond mean-level displacement.
